experiment: E72 Train-only nested query-to-enrollment-template pair protocol

data.official_preprocessing: 1-40 Hz filtered according to the competition description

protocol.roles: outer unknown=4; inner enrolled=8; inner calibration unknown=8; no OE role
protocol.inner_fit: enrolled and trial <= 0.60 * within-subject/task maximum trial
protocol.inner_unknown: all eight inner held-out subjects and trial <= 0.80 * maximum; calibration only
protocol.outer_fit: all 16 enrolled subjects and trial <= 0.80 * maximum
protocol.outer_known_query: all 16 enrolled subjects and trial > 0.80 * maximum; continuous final file block
protocol.outer_unknown: four outer held-out subjects, all trials; final evaluation only
protocol.threshold: q05 of pooled inner-known confidence within each outer group; linear quantile; no threshold grid and no unknown-based threshold selection
protocol.pair_sampling: all query-to-enrolled-template pairs, with one same pair per known query and all other pairs different; unknown-query pairs are all different; no N^2 trial-trial matrix
protocol.model_selection: none; every predeclared feature/space/confidence combination is reported on identical folds
protocol.smoke_scope: first outer group and first inner split only; legacy DINO cache allowed only here

image_audit.legacy_dino_formal_use: forbidden: legacy cache lacks a contemporary E72 lineage manifest and the shared encoder BANDS extend to 90 Hz

gates.aggregation: five outer-fold means; descriptive confirmation only, not outer model selection

reporting.AUROC: known=1, unknown=0 detection AUROC; larger confidence means more known-like
reporting.U_at_95: src.metrics.open_set_metrics: unknown fraction below q05 of the corresponding evaluation known confidences
reporting.working_metrics: C, U, identity macro-F1 and unknown-F1 use the frozen inner-known q05 threshold
reporting.official_score: N/A because RA, ASafeR and A are unavailable in this clean-only experiment
reporting.proxy: 100*C^0.40*U^0.25 is explicitly non-official and omits the adversarial A term
reporting.test: AUC/F1 and all Test metrics are N/A; no public truth and no Test data, index or label was read
reporting.evidence_boundary: Train session1 pseudo-unknown subjects and continuous within-session time blocks only; not real cross-session evidence
